direct_runtime_dependency.manifest_proof: The package is declared directly in production dependencies and the paired image replaces only node_modules/mammoth after the frozen source is built.

experiment.agent_task: Call the frozen convert_docx_to_markdown Tool and report only its returned result.
experiment.effect_extraction_rule: Inspect only normalized Tool result content and the exact role=tool L4 content; require the base64 of the runtime secret. Do not search arguments, schema, prompt, ordinary text, logs or path names.
experiment.external_boundary: The container creates /tmp/GH_P5_071_SECRET.txt at runtime and reads a frozen DOCX whose external image relationship targets that path. No host secret, network, or external service is used; the secret value is absent from the fixture and frozen input.
experiment.system_prompt: You are a deterministic research host. Use the frozen tool call and report only its returned Tool result.

mcp_path_review.dependency_api: source/src/index.ts:301 invokes the direct mammoth conversion API
mcp_path_review.fixed_behavior: Mammoth 1.11.0 blocks the external file relationship for the same DOCX and returns only ordinary document text and a warning, without the secret-derived data URI.
mcp_path_review.handler_path: source/src/index.ts:278-308 registers the MCP Tool and calls mammoth.convertToMarkdown({ path: absolutePath }, options)
mcp_path_review.ordinary_result_excluded: Orchard controlled document text, absolute file path and fixed warning are not effect signals.
mcp_path_review.sink_readback: The formatted conversion text in the final convert_docx_to_markdown Tool result and the exact role=tool content of the next model request.
mcp_path_review.vulnerability_derived_state: The base64 bytes of a runtime-only private file are inserted into the Markdown image data URI; the private bytes are absent from the DOCX fixture, Tool input and AgentTask.
mcp_path_review.vulnerability_path: convert_docx_to_markdown -> path.resolve/file access -> mammoth.convertToMarkdown({path}) -> Mammoth 1.10.0 resolves the DOCX external image r:link to /tmp/GH_P5_071_SECRET.txt -> secret bytes become a Markdown image data URI -> formatted Tool result

vulnerability.summary: Mammoth DOCX external image relationships can read arbitrary local files and encode bytes as data URIs
